title: Fast Art Format (.fart), version 1.5
description: JSON-backed vector art for games: shapes, recolorable palette tokens, re-posable parts, states; since 1.3 also 3D documents (space: "3d") with mesh, ball and rod shapes, and shade on shapes. This schema checks structure; spec/FORMAT.md holds meaning, and the validator in packages/core adds the cross-reference checks a schema cannot express (names resolve, tris index the points). Unknown fields are allowed everywhere: editors preserve them, loaders ignore them.

version.description: The format major. Readers must reject anything newer than they know.

palette_refs.description: Other .fart files whose palettes this one borrows, relative to this file, resolved in order. Later refs beat earlier ones; the local palette beats them all.

space.description: Since 1.3: the document's space. Absent means 2d. A 3D document's points have three coordinates, its shapes are mesh, ball and rod, its turns are [x, y, z]; see FORMAT.md, Space: 3D.

textures.description: Since 1.5: textures, each a set of maps that are drawings tiled over a cell. See FORMAT.md, Textures.

vec2.description: [x, y]; y-down, x-right, in the project's world units.

rgba.description: [r, g, b, a], each 0-255. The field is named rgb and holds four components; the name is retained for compatibility.

relpath.description: A relative path with forward slashes. Never absolute, never a drive letter.

meta.description: Yours. The format never looks inside.

emissive.description: Since 1.2: light the slot gives off; 0 or absent for none.

color.description: A palette token, never a literal color.

shade.description: Since 1.3: multiplies the resolved colour's r, g, b; absent means 1.

texture.description: Since 1.5: a texture of the document, tiled over the shape.

w.description: Stroke width. Round caps. In a collision list, the capsule's girth.

tris.description: Index triples into points, baked by editors on save. The validator checks the count is a multiple of three and every index is in range.

closed.description: Closed fills; open strokes with w.

w.description: The stroke width of an open path, round joins and caps.

then.description: Since 1.7: a cubic polybézier. The validator checks in/out counts, w on an open path, and three points when closed (error path).

drawn_shape.description: A shape inside a part: it is painted, so it names a token.

anchor.description: A named document-space point a runtime may ask for: a grip, a muzzle, a hinge.

angle.description: Since 1.2: the direction an attached thing points, radians in the part's rest space.

pivot.description: Document-space point the runtime rotates about and places. Absent means [0, 0].

parent.description: Since 1.1: the part this one is posed relative to. Must exist; no loops.

like.description: Since 1.2: this part draws that part's shapes and anchors and has none of its own.

offset.description: Where the part's pivot lands. Absent means the pivot itself: the rest placement. Note this is a position, not a delta.

rotate.description: Radians about the pivot. Absent means 0.

scale.description: Multiplier about the pivot. Absent or 0 means 1.

mirror.description: Since 1.2: flipped left-to-right about the pivot, before the turn.

morph.description: Since 1.6: the part's shapes reshaped in this pose; lerped between clip keys.

state.description: A named part list. Its order is paint order; parts it leaves out are not drawn.

key.description: One moment in a clip: a time and a pose, named or inline.

ease.description: How time approaches this key from the previous one. Absent means linear.

curve.description: Since 1.2: a cubic bezier's control points [x1, y1, x2, y2], x within 0..1; wins over ease.

events.description: Since 1.2: names a runtime hears when the playhead crosses this key.

loop.description: Time wraps at the last key. Absent means false.

keys.description: In non-decreasing t; the validator checks the order.

chain.description: Parts root-first, each parented to the previous.

end.description: part/anchor on the chain's last part.

bend.description: Preferred elbow direction where a solution is ambiguous.

target.description: Since 1.2: where a chain should reach, document space.

vec3.description: [x, y, z]; y-down, x-right, z-away, right-handed.

color.description: A palette token, never a literal color.

faces.description: Index loops into points, wound so (p1-p0)x(p2-p0) points outward. The validator checks each has three or more indices in range (error face).

tris.description: Index triples into points, baked by editors on save.

normals.description: Since 1.7: flat (the default) lights each face by its normal; smooth averages vertex normals up to sharp edges. Default smooth once smooth > 0.

angle.description: Since 1.7: degrees; faces meeting at more than this keep their own normals.

smooth.description: Since 1.7: Catmull-Clark subdivision levels; the cage stays the file.

creases.description: Since 1.7: [a, b, c] the edge a–b with crease c in 0–1 (1 is sharp; c × 10 is OpenSubdiv sharpness), or [a, c] a corner.

colors.description: Since 1.8: further palette tokens the faces may wear.

paint.description: Since 1.8: one index per face: 0 is color, n is colors[n-1]. The validator checks the count and the range (error paint).

mods.description: Since 1.8: modifiers applied to the cage in order.

shades.description: Since 1.8: one number per point, multiplying shade there. The validator checks the count (error shades).

host.description: The joints are parts of the host: the document this one is drawn on.

weights.description: One entry per point: pairs of [index into joints, weight], one to four pairs adding up to 1.

skin.description: Since 1.9: the mesh gives at its joints: each point placed by several parts' world maps, weighted. The validator checks the joints, the count and the entries (error skin).

uvs.description: The cage's explicit pattern coordinates on the surface: one list per face of the bake, one pair per corner.

uvOf.description: A hash of the cage's mapping.uvs the bake's uvs came from.

paint.description: Since 1.8: the paint of the bake's own faces.

shades.description: Since 1.8: the shade of the bake's own points.

bake.description: Since 1.7: the subdivided (or generated) surface, written by fart bake --smooth; of hashes the cage (since 1.8 with its mods, paint and shades).

profile.description: A path body: [radius, along] pairs for a lathe; a closed outline in the plane's other two axes for an extrude; for a pipe (1.8), an optional closed section in place of the circle; for a rail (1.11), [out, along] pairs, open or closed.

segments.description: Steps around the axis for a lathe, 12 by default; sides of a round pipe's section, 8 by default; steps in a quarter turn of a rail's rounded corner, 4 by default.

path.description: Since 1.8, a pipe's spine: a path body with three coordinates. Since 1.11 a rail's too.

radius.description: Since 1.8: the section's scale (a round pipe's radius); 1 by default.

radii.description: Since 1.8: one factor per path point, multiplying radius there, linear between. The validator checks the count (error pipe).

caps.description: Since 1.8: close the ends of an open pipe; true by default.

closed.description: Since 1.8: the pipe's path joins its last point to its first. Since 1.11 a rail's too.

round.description: Since 1.11, a rail: the radius its path's corners are rounded to; 0 by default.

normals.description: Since 1.7: flat (the default) lights each face by its normal; smooth averages vertex normals up to sharp edges. Default smooth once smooth > 0.

angle.description: Since 1.7: degrees; faces meeting at more than this keep their own normals.

smooth.description: Since 1.7: Catmull-Clark subdivision levels; the cage stays the file.

creases.description: Since 1.7: [a, b, c] the edge a–b with crease c in 0–1 (1 is sharp; c × 10 is OpenSubdiv sharpness), or [a, c] a corner.

colors.description: Since 1.8: further palette tokens the faces may wear.

paint.description: Since 1.8: one index per face: 0 is color, n is colors[n-1]. The validator checks the count and the range (error paint).

mods.description: Since 1.8: modifiers applied to the cage in order.

uvs.description: The cage's explicit pattern coordinates on the surface: one list per face of the bake, one pair per corner.

uvOf.description: A hash of the cage's mapping.uvs the bake's uvs came from.

paint.description: Since 1.8: the paint of the bake's own faces.

shades.description: Since 1.8: the shade of the bake's own points.

bake.description: Since 1.7: the subdivided (or generated) surface, written by fart bake --smooth; of hashes the cage (since 1.8 with its mods, paint and shades).

then.description: Since 1.7: a solid generated from a profile, kept as the profile; since 1.8 also op pipe, a section carried along a path; since 1.11 op rail, a profile carried upright along one. Never in collision.

drawn_shape3.description: A 3D shape inside a part: painted, so it names a token.

dir.description: The direction an attached thing points, in the part's rest space.

rotate.description: Radians about the pivot: about x, then y, then z. Absent means [0, 0, 0].

morph.description: Since 1.6: the part's meshes reshaped in this pose; lerped between clip keys.

key3.description: One moment in a clip: a time and a pose, named or inline.

ease.description: How time approaches this key from the previous one. Absent means linear.

curve.description: Since 1.2: a cubic bezier's control points [x1, y1, x2, y2], x within 0..1; wins over ease.

events.description: Since 1.2: names a runtime hears when the playhead crosses this key.

pole.description: A document-space point the first elbow leans toward.

collision_shape.description: A 2D collision shape: a document shape with, since 1.4, an optional part it rides and a layer an engine reads.

collision_shape3.description: A 3D collision shape: ball, rod, a convex mesh, or a box (collision only); optionally riding a part, with a layer.

soften.description: Since 1.8: a Gaussian blur over the map, its deviation in pattern units, wrapping at the cell.

relief.description: Since 1.8: how far the height map's value 1 stands proud of 0, in pattern units.

shape.description: Index into the part's own shapes; only a poly (2D) or a mesh (3D) morphs.

points.description: The shape's points in this pose, replacing the base's whole: the same count, the same order.

in.description: Since 1.7: a path's in-handles in this pose.

morph.description: Since 1.6: a shape's points as they are in this pose. The validator checks the part is not like another, the shape exists and has points, and the count matches (error morph).

in.description: Since 1.7: a path's in-handles in this pose.

morph3.description: Since 1.6: a mesh's points in this pose (see morph).

path_bake.description: Since 1.7: the flattened polygon, baked on save; a reader that does not flatten draws it as a poly.

handles.description: One tangent handle per point, relative to it; [0,0] or absent is a corner.

normals.description: Since 1.7: flat (the default) lights each face by its normal; smooth averages vertex normals up to sharp edges. Default smooth once smooth > 0.

angle.description: Since 1.7: degrees; faces meeting at more than this keep their own normals.

smooth.description: Since 1.7: Catmull-Clark subdivision levels; the cage stays the file.

creases.description: Since 1.7: [a, b, c] the edge a–b with crease c in 0–1 (1 is sharp; c × 10 is OpenSubdiv sharpness), or [a, c] a corner.

paint.description: Since 1.8: the paint of the bake's own faces.

shades.description: Since 1.8: the shade of the bake's own points.

bake.description: Since 1.7: the subdivided (or generated) surface, written by fart bake --smooth; of hashes the cage.

handles3.description: Since 1.8: one tangent handle per point of a path in space, relative to it; [0,0,0] or absent is a corner.

op.description: mirror, solidify or crease. The validator refuses any other (error mod).

merge.description: Points this near the plane weld and are pinned to it; 0.001 by default.

offset.description: -1 (the default): the wall grows inward from the cage; 1: outward; between, in proportion.

inner.description: A paint index for the inner faces; absent, each wears its source face's.

rim.description: A paint index for the rim; absent, each quad wears the paint of the face its edge belongs to.

angle.description: Degrees, 30 by default: edges whose faces meet at more than this are creased.

value.description: The crease, 0–1 (error crease outside it); 1 by default.

mod.description: Since 1.8: one modifier of a cage, applied in list order after a morph and before smooth.

parts.description: 3D: parts with three-coordinate pivots and mesh, ball, rod shapes.
Layers with a pivot. File order is paint order when no state says otherwise.

clips.description: Animation: states in time. See FORMAT.md, Clips.

constraints.description: Inverse kinematics chains a runtime may solve live. See FORMAT.md, Constraints.

collision.description: Shapes a game may treat as solid. Never drawn, so color is optional. Document space at rest, or a part's rest space when part is named (1.4).
